route_summary: One blind attempt, which closed its own route by proving it. The ring generated by the triangular lattice and the spindle rotation, Z[zeta][rho], is exactly 4-chromatic via an explicit colouring, so no construction inside it -- more copies, more centres, deeper ladder levels, bigger Cayley balls -- can reach five colours. Do not re-attempt anything inside that ring. The open arena the attempt identifies is the mixed groups containing rho_4; read attempt 001's obstruction section and Lead 1 before proposing any rotation-based construction.

attempts.one_line: Proved that the entire ring generated by the triangular lattice and the Moser spindle rotation is exactly 4-chromatic, by an explicit colouring, so no construction inside it can ever witness five colours -- which retro-explains a census, four kinds of search and Cayley balls to 10315 vertices that all returned 4.
attempts.range: The colouring rule is proved for the whole ring and checked at ladder levels 0-8 (all 24k+18 unit vectors per level) and on real balls up to 10315 vertices and 77016 edges with zero monochromatic edges. Census: all 30 Eisenstein norms n <= 79 at patch norm 79. Interface bound cross-checked on 112 (n, patch) pairs. Capping sweep: 39 rotation groups. Largest certified graph in the earlier phase 751 vertices and 3796 edges. Nothing bears on chi(R^2) beyond the classical 4; the ring is one countable point set, not the plane.
gaps: The mixed groups containing rho_4, above all E + rho_3 E + rho_4 E, admit no mod-2 capping functional and were not settled: neither a capping quotient nor a non-4-colourable ball was found. That is the one arena this attempt leaves open.
The census rule 'chi = 4 iff 3 | n' is a correlation over 30 values of n plus an algebraic characterisation of the split, with no proof connecting them.
The capping sweep covers one- and two-rotation groups with n <= 21 only, and the conjecture that failures are exactly the groups containing a rotation of even denominator is untested beyond that.

The constructible closure under circle intersections is strictly larger than the ring -- halving is exactly what the mod-2 colouring cannot survive -- and was not computed, for want of a square-root routine in multiquadratic fields.

attempts.methodological_lesson: Eight of nine push rounds were searches; every one returned '4-colourable' without saying why, and the ninth was a five-line algebraic check that settled all of them at once and would have done so before any search was run. When a search family keeps returning the same answer, look for the invariant that forces it rather than for a bigger instance. Separately, the two-implementation rule caught two silent errors that produced entirely plausible numbers: a wrong common denominator in field addition, and an inclusion-exclusion identity mislabelled as a colouring count.
attempts.design_note: harness/hadwiger-nelson holds only what PROBLEM.md asks of it -- exact field arithmetic, the two-sided certifier, and the colouring checkers, now including a scaling solver -- while the lattice, ring and rotation constructors sit in explore/, because they encode this route and would steer a blind agent.
